description:
- Added RuStore 1.113.2.0 support.
- Added patches that disable review prompts, ad-link auto-install and TV install.
- Blocked push metrics and promo tracking pixels.
- Startup now cancels background work left from earlier versions.

patches.name: Block remote network policy
patches.description: Blocks remote and cached network policies that add TLS trust anchors or override API and static-content hosts.

patches.name: Disable Kaspersky background scan
patches.description: Disables periodic Kaspersky scheduling and reports disabled workers as successfully completed.

patches.name: Disable TV install
patches.description: Removes local network and multicast access and disables scanning the network for TVs to install apps over ADB.

patches.name: Disable ad-link auto-install
patches.description: Requires a tap to install apps opened from ad links instead of starting the install automatically.

patches.name: Disable advertisements
patches.description: Removes ad providers, sanitizes ad identifiers, returns an empty ad list, blocks promo tracking pixels, and keeps advertising consent disabled.

patches.name: Disable analytics and trackers
patches.description: Disables audited analytics transports, including VK Push metrics, and replaces the stable request device identifier.

patches.name: Disable background hooks
patches.description: Disables audited boot, network-state, VPN, and Connect session hooks.

patches.name: Disable invasive permissions
patches.description: Removes privileged install, location, storage, billing, USB, and vendor data access while preserving user-driven installs.

patches.name: Disable push services
patches.description: Disables RuStore and VK push initialization, services, and audited push receivers.

patches.name: Disable review prompts
patches.description: Hides app rating prompts and stops sending installed catalog apps to the rating-status service.

patches.name: Disable verification hooks
patches.description: Disables audited SMS, call, phone-state, SID, and Mail.ru verification hooks.

patches.name: Exclude Google Play apps from update checks
patches.description: Excludes only apps whose recorded Android installer is Google Play from update requests.

patches.name: Hide gaming profile
patches.description: Removes the gaming profile permission, hides the gaming profile widget, and blocks navigation to the gaming profile.

patches.name: Replace RuStore SDK device identifier
patches.description: Replaces the RuStore SDK device identifier sent with payment and session requests with the zero UUID.

patches.name: Replace VK SDK device identifier
patches.description: Replaces the VK SDK device fingerprint sent by VK ID and VK Pay request paths with the zero UUID.

patches.name: Restore secure-session compatibility
patches.description: Adapts secure-session requests to RuStore 1.108 API changes for re-signed APKs.

patches.name: Restrict background work to updates
patches.description: Keeps only the workers required for automatic updates and allows update checks to run while RuStore is foreground or background.

patches.name: Skip update authentication
patches.description: Skips the update authentication suggestion and returns a valid completed result.

release_notes:
- Added RuStore 1.113.2.0 support.
- Added patches that disable review prompts, ad-link auto-install and TV install.
- Blocked push metrics and promo tracking pixels.
- Startup now cancels background work left from earlier versions.
repoDescription: Selectable RuStore privacy patches for Morphe with verified automatic releases.
